speaker: SIGNORE MORO
text: Hello and welcome to the Community Centre. How can I help you today?

speaker: YOU
text: I was told I could pick up a taxi driver's license here. Can you tell me where to go?

speaker: SIGNORE MORO
text: Well, you have found the right place. May I have your name, please?

speaker: SIGNORE MORO
text: That's a mighty fine name, [YOU], please sign below.

speaker: SIGNORE MORO
text:
Congratulations! You are officially a licensed taxi driver!

To launch your career, the local authorities are providing a Starter Business Bonus.
Best of luck with your new endeavor!
